blockers: PUBLIC_RELAY_ENDPOINT_NOT_DEPLOYED: no production HTTPS relay host exists; the package is built with --mcp-url only after the owner deploys a self-hosted relay on a host they control
DOMAIN_CHALLENGE_TOKEN_NOT_ISSUED: OpenAI issues the /.well-known/openai-apps-challenge token only in the owner's platform account
LEGAL_DOCUMENTS_NOT_OWNER_APPROVED: docs/legal/PRIVACY.md and docs/legal/TERMS.md are drafts that the owner must review and publish
DEMO_RECORDING_NOT_CAPTURED: the walkthrough video requires the owner's paired computer and account
REVIEWER_TEST_ACCOUNT_NOT_PROVISIONED: OpenAI review needs a dedicated test account with a paired computer

promotion_rule: No software, test, or CI result promotes any state. Provider-controlled states change only by recording directly observed provider evidence (submission ID, review decision, directory listing URL, or a target-account observation) in this file through a governed change.
